jobs:
  j:
    steps:
      - name: txe's TXE-7835 instance (a removal that failed into /dev/null turned the step red)
        run: |
          trap 'docker rm -f "pg-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" >/dev/null 2>&1' EXIT # want:trap-status
          go test ./...
      - name: fixed
        run: |
          trap 'RC=$?; docker rm -f "pg-$GITHUB_RUN_ID" >/dev/null || echo "::warning::could not remove pg"; exit "$RC"' EXIT
          go test ./...
      - run: trap 'rm -f "$probe"' EXIT # want:trap-status
      - name: not shell
        with:
          script: trap 'rm -f x' EXIT
